def fingerprint(value):
    a=np.ascontiguousarray(value)
    return {'shape':list(a.shape),'dtype':a.dtype.str,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(a.tobytes()).hexdigest()}

cache=read(plan['cache']['path']);assert len(cache['batches'])==1000
cache_fields=0
for row in cache['batches']:
    assert ref(row['arrays']['path'])==row['arrays'] and ref(row['parent']['path'])==row['parent']
    a=dict(np.load(row['arrays']['path']));base=np.load(row['parent']['path'])
    assert {k:fingerprint(v) for k,v in a.items()}==row['inputs']
    assert fingerprint(base)==row['parent_values'] and np.isfinite(base).all()
    cache_fields+=len(a)+1
training=read(root/'train-result-v1.json');assert ref(training['checkpoint']['path'])==training['checkpoint']
state=torch.load(training['checkpoint']['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)

assert sum(len(arm['state']) for arm in state['optimizers'].values())==91
review=read(root/'review-result-v1.json');design=read(root/'quality-design-v1.json')
cases={c['id']:c for c in design['observations']};assert len(cases)==822
maps={};prediction_paths=set();forward_inputs=ADC_constants=0
for label,binding in review['collections'].items():
    assert ref(binding['path'])==binding
    c=read(binding['path']);assert c['module_before']==c['module_after'] and c['component_forwards']==822
    assert c['RNG_unchanged'] and c['adopted_array_storage_after_actual_replay']==(c['arm']=='paired-control')
    assert ref(c['export']['path'])==c['export']
    export=torch.load(c['export']['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
    key='models' if c['endpoint']=='raw' else 'emas'
    assert len(export['state_dict'])==(45 if c['arm']=='paired-control' else 46) and export['parent']==state['parent']
    assert all(torch.equal(v,state[key][c['arm']][n]) for n,v in export['state_dict'].items())
    maps[label]={r['id']:r['prediction'] for r in c['observations']}
    for row,case in zip(c['observations'],design['observations'],strict=True):
        assert row['id']==case['id'] and row['parent']==case['parent'] and row['module_forwards']==1
        assert ref(row['prediction']['path'])==row['prediction']
        assert Path(row['prediction']['path']).is_relative_to('/mnt/external')
        assert row['prediction']['path'] not in prediction_paths;prediction_paths.add(row['prediction']['path'])
        a=dict(np.load(case['arrays']['path']));value=np.load(row['prediction']['path'])
        assert fingerprint(value)==row['values'] and value.dtype==np.float32 and np.isfinite(value).all()
        for field,f in row['inputs'].items():assert fingerprint(a[field])==f;forward_inputs+=1
        if case['kind']=='flat' and case['noise']['name']=='adc-only' and case.get('cohort')!='adc-sloped512':
            assert np.array_equal(value,np.load(case['parent']['path']));ADC_constants+=1
assert len(prediction_paths)==3288 and forward_inputs==13152 and ADC_constants==192
# Independently bind exact archived control state/trace and all context-off arrays.

old=torch.load(baseline['checkpoint']['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)

for key in ['models','emas','optimizers']:

for a,b in zip(training['trace'],baseline['trace'],strict=True):
    assert a['step']==b['step'] and a['batch']==b['batch'] and a['arms']['paired-control']==b['arms']['paired-response']
control_paths=set()
for label,binding in review['collections'].items():
    c=read(binding['path'])
    if c['arm']!='paired-control':continue
    prior=read(c['original_control_collection']['path'])
    for a,b in zip(c['observations'],prior['observations'],strict=True):
        assert a['id']==b['id'] and a['prediction']==b['prediction'] and a['archive_replayed_bit_exact']
        control_paths.add(a['prediction']['path'])
assert len(control_paths)==review['control_replayed_exact']==1644
assert review['new_prediction_arrays']==1644
removal=read(root/'context-removal-result-v1.json');assert removal['head_calls']==48 and len(removal['records'])==24
removal_paths=set();effect_checks=0
for r in removal['records']:
    assert r['on_prediction']==maps[r['endpoint']][r['id']]
    assert ref(r['off_prediction']['path'])==r['off_prediction']
    path=Path(r['off_prediction']['path']);assert path.is_relative_to('/mnt/external') and str(path) not in prediction_paths
    removal_paths.add(str(path));off=np.load(path);on=np.load(r['on_prediction']['path'])
    assert fingerprint(off)==r['off_values'] and off.dtype==np.float32 and np.isfinite(off).all()
    effect=(on.astype(np.float64)-off.astype(np.float64))*65535
    rms=float(np.linalg.norm(effect.ravel())/np.sqrt(effect.size));maximum=float(np.max(np.abs(effect)))
    assert abs(rms-r['effect_RMS_DN16'])<1e-10 and maximum==r['effect_maximum_abs_DN16'];effect_checks+=2
    assert r['on_replayed_bit_exact'] and r['direct_spatial_path_bit_exact']
assert len(removal_paths)==24 and effect_checks==48

    'Harmonic raw1k':'harmonic-context-raw-step1000','Harmonic EMA1k':'harmonic-context-EMA-step1000'}

for original,item in zip(figures['images'],public['images'],strict=True):
    assert item['original_image']==original['image'] and ref(item['image']['path'])==item['image']
    assert Path(item['image']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(original['image']['path']).read_bytes()
    assert item['no_resize'] and item['ROI_xywh']==original['ROI_xywh']
    case=item['case'];a=dict(np.load(case['arrays']['path']));roi=item['ROI_xywh']
    image=np.asarray(Image.open(item['image']['path']));anchor=np.array(item['anchor']).reshape(1,3,1,1)
    for panel in item['panels']:
        name=panel['label'];is_JPEG=False
        if name=='Noisy Malvar':value=noisy_malvar(a)
        elif name=='V143 parent':value=np.load(case['parent']['path'])
        elif name in aliases:value=np.load(maps[aliases[name]][case['id']]['path'])
        elif name in retained:
            binding=retained[name][case['id']];assert ref(binding['path'])==binding;value=np.load(binding['path'])
        elif name=='Periodic detail':value=np.load(case['periodic_detail']['path'])

            value=a['reference_rgb'] if 'reference_rgb' in a else np.load(case['reference_binding']['path']) if case['kind']=='real' else a['target']
        else:
            assert name in ['ISO6400 JPEG native','ISO100 JPEG, not GT']
            window=next(w for w in case['cases'] if w['ROI_xywh']==roi)
            key='noisy_camera_jpeg' if name.startswith('ISO6400') else 'reference_camera_jpeg'
            binding=window['camera_JPEGs'][key]['pixels'];assert ref(binding['path'])==binding
            value=np.load(binding['path']);is_JPEG=True
        selected_roi=[0,0,160,160] if name=='ISO100 AHD, not GT' and value.shape[-2:]==(160,160) else roi
        expected=value if is_JPEG else independent_display(anchor+item['contrast']*(value.astype(np.float64)-anchor),a,selected_roi,item['exposure'])
        x,y,w,h=panel['xywh'];assert w==h==160 and expected.shape==(160,160,3)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(image[y:y+h,x:x+w],expected);channels+=expected.size
